audit.whatIsWrong: Stored rows read Skill, Shen, Shen, Skill, Skill, Shen, Shen. The prose says the opposite at both ends: the early paragraph opens 'Shen owns levels 1-3', and whys[4], whys[5], whys[6] each say level 6, first item and late all flip to Vladimir.
audit.why: The packet levelChart (Shen, Shen, Shen, Skill, Vladimir, Vladimir, Vladimir) matches every whys[] line; the stored rows contradict four of them, so the page currently tells the reader Shen wins late while the paragraph underneath says Vladimir does.
audit.corrected: Row 0 becomes Shen; rows 4, 5 and 6 become Vladimir. Rows 1-3 are already correct.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown or resource number appears for any Shen ability, and Stand United's cooldown is never given despite the page telling you to punish every cast.
audit.why: Twilight Assault is 8s at rank 1 down to 5s and costs 140 energy falling to 100; Shadow Dash is 18s down to 10s at 150 energy; Spirit's Refuge is 16s down to 10s; Stand United is 200/180/160s. Vladimir's pool is 28s at rank 1, slower than Shadow Dash at every rank.
audit.corrected: The free-shove window is 200s at rank 1, not every wave. After a Shadow Dash Shen has spent 150 energy and cannot follow with Q at rank 1 cost.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page has a 'Fight his W block' entry but never states what Spirit's Refuge actually blocks. Riot's text: attacks that would hit Shen or his allies near his spirit blade are blocked. It stops ATTACKS, not abilities. Stand United being an interruptible channel is also never stated despite a 'Don't ignore his R' entry.
audit.why: Vladimir's whole damage pattern is Transfusion and Tides of Blood — abilities. Telling him to avoid fighting into the W zone gives away free damage that the zone cannot stop.
audit.corrected: Spirit's Refuge blocks attacks only — Transfusion (Q) and Tides of Blood (E) land straight through it. Stand United is a channel and global: any CC cancels it, and being low HP anywhere on the map is a decision, not a default. Tides of Blood is blocked by enemy units, so charge it behind your own wave.

edits.before: - Shen Shadow Dash: matchup-defining — His engage CC. Pool after it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Shadow Dash: 18s at rank 1, 10s at rank 5, and 150 energy — right after a taunt he cannot afford Q. - Spirit's Refuge blocks attacks only, so Transfusion and Tides of Blood land through it. - Hemoplague: 120s.

edits.after: Shen's window is his early sustain — Ki Barrier plus Twilight Assault (Q), an 8s max-health hit at rank 1, wins short trades and shrugs off your Transfusion chip while he farms safely at 400 range.

notes: Win rate here is 48.44% over 739 games — Vladimir is the losing side — yet the packet chart and every whys[] line hand him levels 6 onward. I followed the packet and the prose because they agree with each other and with the kit (Shen has no scaling damage), but the reader now sees a losing win rate above a chart Vladimir wins 3-1. Worth a champion-level look at whether the late rows should be Skill instead. Also: Stand United's 200s rank-1 cooldown means 'every Stand United roam gifts you a free lane window' (whys[4], spikes[1], wants.you[1], mid) overstates the frequency — it happens roughly three times a game, not per wave. I left those strings alone rather than reword four fields inside the length band.
